Bassist Walter Booker and drummer Jimmy Cobb, currently working with the Nat Adderley Quintet, make up one of the finest rhythm teams in jazz today.
They have been the propelling force behind some of the greatest jazz soloists, including Miles Davis, Cannonball Adderley, Dinah Washington and Dizzy Gillespie.
Walter and Jimmy were interviewed by Michael Woods on a Royal Caribbean

We are on board the Royal Caribbean cruise line and we are filming a jazz archive presentation for Hamilton College. My name is Dr. Michael Woods and my guests today is Jimmy Cobb and Walter Booker, two of the finest rhythm section players in the world. And we’re going to talk to them about their experiences in jazz. Just share with me, who were you listening to when you were a kid when you decided you wanted to play the drums?
